Overview

Tunja is a city in BY with a population of 200,000. A historic highland city with well-preserved colonial architecture, an important educational and cultural center. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
